clue.text: Converted ground to lawn, with major extension

blocks.note: taken as written, all twelve letters

explanation.surface: A gardener turns rough ground into a lawn, a big landscaping job.
explanation.definitionFit: Something long-drawn-out has been stretched far beyond its natural length, an adjectival idiom for prolonged.

clue.text: You reportedly gambol freely about - back in trouble with this?

moving freely means the letters are not held in their order

blocks.note: the letter U is pronounced like the word you
taken as written

explanation.surface: A jolly warning: caper about too freely and you may hurt your back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is padding to the surface rather than a second instruction; U and GAMBOL are mixed together.
explanation.definitionFit: Lumbago is pain in the lower spine, the condition someone with a bad back suffers.

the indefinite article

explanation.definitionFit: Norma is a female first name, so any woman bearing it fits the definition.

everything is all
taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Dalliance means idle trifling or dawdling, time spent on nothing of value.

clue.text: Item included by National Socialists

explanation.walkthrough: 'Item' is not a thing here but the old Latin adverb used in lists and accounts to mean likewise.
explanation.definitionFit: Item, in old inventories, is an adverb meaning likewise or moreover, introducing each further entry.

clue.text: Trains run true to form on the second

blocks.note: taken as written
S is the abbreviation for second

explanation.walkthrough: 'Trains' looks like railway carriages but is the verb meaning brings up.
explanation.definitionFit: To nurture is to rear and educate a child, so trains as a verb is a near synonym.

clue.text: Taking advantage of pleasant morning off

blocks.note: something pleasant is amusing

explanation.surface: Someone makes the most of a nice morning off work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'morning off' sounds like a day's holiday but instructs the solver to drop the morning abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Using someone means exploiting them, which is exactly taking advantage of them.

clue.text: Fine adjustment needed in transmitting equipment, that's apparent

taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'Fine adjustment' reads as precise tuning; 'Fine' is the letters and 'adjustment' the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Manifest as an adjective means plain to see, so it is a straight synonym for obvious.

clue.text: Best - or worst - of French performance

blocks.note: de is French for of
a feat is an accomplishment or performance

explanation.definitionFit: To best or to worst someone is to beat them, which is what defeat means as a verb.

clue.text: Pious teacher who's mean about examination?

explanation.walkthrough: 'who's mean' needs a noun, the mean person, around the exam.
explanation.definitionFit: A moraliser preaches about right and wrong, lecturing others in a self-righteous way.

clue.text: Picture that's used as cover for publication

explanation.walkthrough: 'that's' looks like a link but supplies the Latin abbreviation, which splits around the magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: An image is a picture or likeness, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: US agents outside pub, having returned from part of Asia

blocks.note: the Central Intelligence Agency
a bar is a pub

explanation.walkthrough: The pub sits between CI and A, and the whole string is then turned round.

clue.text: Sticky situation in yearly business gathering covered by paper

blocks.note: a quire is a set of 24 or 25 sheets of paper
an annual general meeting

explanation.walkthrough: 'paper' looks like a newspaper, but it is a quantity of writing sheets.
explanation.definitionFit: A quagmire is literally a bog and figuratively a predicament one cannot easily escape.

clue.text: Vital components in means of communication

blocks.note: first meaning: parts of a living body such as the heart
second meaning: newspapers or journals that speak for a group

explanation.surface: Key parts inside a messaging system.
explanation.definitionFit: Heart and lungs are bodily examples, while a party newspaper is called its official mouthpiece in the same sense.

clue.text: Augment mixture with lake that's sort of grey

indicators.note: a mixture blends things together, so the letters are jumbled

blocks.note: taken as written
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A painter adds a lake pigment to a blend to get a greyish shade.
explanation.walkthrough: Lake is also a pigment, which helps the painting picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Gunmetal is a dull bluish shade named after the bronze alloy once used for cannon.

clue.text: Rejected advance incorporated in payment not forthcoming

incorporated in says this goes inside the payment

blocks.note: to cite is to put forward or advance an argument
rent is a regular payment

explanation.walkthrough: 'advance' looks like a loan of money, but it is the verb meaning put forward.
explanation.definitionFit: Reticent means reserved or reluctant to speak, the opposite of open and forthcoming.

clue.text: Club mount get-together for old track runner

blocks.note: an iron is a golf club
a horse is a mount for a rider

explanation.surface: A golf club and a riding club hold a joint event for a retired racehorse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'track runner' suggests an athlete or racehorse; the track is a railway line.
explanation.definitionFit: Iron horse is a dated nickname for a steam locomotive, which ran on railway tracks.

clue.text: Outstanding account showed effect of inflation

blocks.note: a bill is an account to be paid
an outstanding sum is still owed

explanation.surface: An unpaid bill reveals how prices have risen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inflation' reads as rising prices, which suits the bill, but the definition means swelling with air.
explanation.definitionFit: Sails billowed when filled with wind, swelling outwards as if blown up like a balloon.

clue.text: Widespread complaint producing unending protest in alarm

explanation.walkthrough: 'complaint' means an illness here, not a grumble.
explanation.definitionFit: A pandemic is a disease spreading across a whole country or the world.

clue.text: Use shares to generate turnover in farming business

definitions.text: Use shares to generate turnover in farming business

blocks.note: surface reading: invest stock to make a company's sales grow
setter's reading: the blades of a farm implement turning over the soil

explanation.walkthrough: Shares and turnover sound like finance; on a farm, shares are the cutting blades and turnover is what they do to the earth.
explanation.definitionFit: Ploughing breaks and turns the soil using ploughshares, the iron blades of the implement.

clue.text: Planned course completely in flight

blocks.note: first meaning: sent along a chosen path
second meaning: an army utterly beaten and fleeing

explanation.surface: A pilot has mapped the whole journey while airborne.
explanation.definitionFit: Directed along a path is one sense; defeated decisively and driven off is the military sense.

clue.text: Show girl's set on dramatic production

blocks.note: Di is a girl's name, with the possessive s

explanation.definitionFit: A display is an exhibition or show put on for viewers.

clue.text: Bid higher for garment, securing first of collection

indicators.note: first of keeps only the opening letter

the initial of the word

explanation.definitionFit: To overcall in bridge is to make a higher bid than the opponent's previous one.

clue.text: Painter inferior to Constable as producer of oil

blocks.note: a cop is a police constable
Royal Academician

explanation.surface: A painter ranks below John Constable, who worked in oils.
explanation.walkthrough: Constable looks like the landscape painter, but here it means a policeman.
explanation.definitionFit: Copra is dried coconut kernel, pressed to yield coconut oil.

clue.text: Barmaid enters backstreet in old city

explanation.walkthrough: 'backstreet' reads as one word but splits into reversal signal and street.
explanation.definitionFit: Thebes was an ancient city, both in Greece and the capital of ancient Egypt.

clue.text: Emerge victorious astride a wild animal

indicators.note: sitting astride means straddling, one leg on each side, so it surrounds

taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: A beast is any animal, especially a large or untamed one.

clue.text: Ruler taking venomous creature in embrace

blocks.note: Georgius Rex, King George

taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: A cascade is a steep fall of water, which is what a waterfall is.
